$comment: Screenshot manifest consumed by capture-screenshots.mjs. Each entry: path (admin route after /dashboard), out (file under static/img/screenshots), waitFor (selector to await before capture), clip (optional element selector to clip to; omitted = main content area), and notes. Routes assume the seeded local site (John Forja / localhost:4321).
